_about: QB status per team. qb1_out true only when two sources agree. Updated Wed Nov 11 for the trade deadline (transactions.json). SEA: Darnold ruled out, Lock starts (FOX 13 Seattle Nov 9 plus seahawks.com). BAL: Lamar Jackson out, Jacoby Brissett (traded from ARI Nov 6) starts (NFL.com Nov 9, Minter; ClutchPoints). ARI: Minshew to IR (elbow), rookie Carson Beck starts (Washington Post Nov 10, azfamily Nov 11). MIN: Kirk Cousins acquired from LV Nov 10, expected starter over Murray (hamstring) (CBS Minnesota Nov 10, NFL.com and Heavy Nov 11). LV: Cousins traded, Fernando Mendoza starts (NFL.com Nov 10, DK Network Nov 10). MIA: Malik Willis to IR (groin), Kyle McCord starts (ESPN and Yahoo Nov 10). pts_off: points off the team in the model (default signals.json qb_out_pts 3.0, the fitted QB change value); MIN uses the trade rule in transactions.py (new starter better rated than the starter he replaces, half credit in his first week). Nov 12: WAS Daniels and NYG McCarthy confirmed for Thursday (official report plus team and Field Level Media news). Nov 13: MIN Cousins named by two sources (CBS Minnesota, NFL Network Rapoport), status Confirmed; SEA Lock Questionable (elbow, oblique).

PHI.note: out for the season, blood clots (notes.json Oct 27; McKee started the Oct 26 Monday game). McKee Questionable (rib, limited) on the Week 9 report

BAL.note: Lamar Jackson out (thumb, IR). Jacoby Brissett, acquired from Arizona Nov 6, expected to start Week 10 (NFL.com Nov 9, coach Jesse Minter; ClutchPoints). Fagnano started Week 9; Huntley (toe) out for the season.

SEA.note: Darnold (quad) out for Week 10, expected back Week 12 (ESPN Nov 10; FOX 13 Seattle Nov 9). Drew Lock starts but is Questionable (right elbow and oblique), limited Thursday (seahawks.com, John Boyle, Nov 13); Jalen Milroe is next.

MIN.note: Kirk Cousins acquired from Las Vegas Nov 10 and expected to start at Green Bay (CBS Minnesota Nov 10; NFL Network, Ian Rapoport, Nov 13). Murray (hamstring) Doubtful and did not practice; Wentz (ankle) limited, Questionable. Cousins is rated 69 against Murray 33, worth about 1.1 points to Minnesota at half credit in his first week.

ARI.note: Minshew (elbow, likely season ending) placed on IR Nov 10; rookie Carson Beck makes his first start (Washington Post Nov 10, azfamily Nov 11). Season starter Jacoby Brissett was benched, then traded to Baltimore Nov 6.

LV.note: Season starter Kirk Cousins traded to Minnesota Nov 10; No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza named the starter (NFL.com Nov 10; DK Network Nov 10).

MIA.note: Malik Willis placed on IR Nov 10 (groin, out at least four games); Kyle McCord makes his first NFL start (ESPN and Yahoo Sports, Nov 10).

WAS.note: Daniels (left elbow) full participant all week, no game designation (official report via giants.com Nov 11). Only Out: C Lucas Patrick (concussion), TE Colson Yankoff (knee). WR Treylon Burks (foot) DNP Wednesday, no designation.

NYG.note: McCarthy (hip) full participant Tue and Wed, no game designation (official report via giants.com Nov 11; Field Level Media Nov 9: Harbaugh says he will play). RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) full participant, no designation, expected back as lead back (Fantasy Footballers Nov 10). LB Malik Harrison Questionable.
